title: Opponent keepAlive bridge can miss GAME_OVER after a concede
description: During `xvfb-run -a make regen-golden K='mana_drain_fact_or_fiction or emancipation_angel_trigger or multi_amount_combat'` on 2026-03-15, the `emancipation_angel_trigger` scenario completed in the server and spectator, but the losing keepAlive bridge never observed `GAME_OVER`. The bridge log showed `passPriority STILL WAITING` more than 60s after player A conceded, while `tmp/golden-opponent/bridge-events.jsonl` showed `END_GAME_INFO` without a preceding `GAME_OVER`. Golden cleanup eventually recovered by restarting the opponent bridge, but the replay phase for that scenario stretched to 121s instead of the usual ~10-20s. This leaves keepAlive cleanup nondeterministic and risks future bridge_join or replay timeout flakes whenever the loser stays blocked in `passPriority` after a concede.
